name: CMSB
recent: Cahya Mata Sarawak 近期围绕股东 Abu Bekir 要求查阅公司财务记录的法律纠纷持续发展，高等法院部分批准查阅后，公司获得临时暂缓令。公司同时公布了截至2026年6月30日的季度业绩，营收同比增长18.2%。
notable: 高等法院部分批准股东 Abu Bekir 查阅公司财务记录，公司随后获得临时暂缓令。
公司公布截至2026年6月30日季度业绩，营收同比增长18.2%。
审计委员会成员出现变动，Jeyabalan A/L S.K. Parasingam 及 Gee Siew Yoong 先后有职务调整。
risks: 股东 Abu Bekir 查阅公司财务记录的诉讼仍在进行，法院已部分批准查阅，公司获得临时暂缓令。
季度净利环比下降6.8%，净利率由8.6%降至7.7%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 MYR 291.974 million，同比增长18.2%，环比增长4.9%；净利为 MYR 22.441 million，环比下降6.8%，净利率为7.7%，低于上一季度的8.6%。

recent_en: Cahya Mata Sarawak has seen ongoing legal developments over shareholder Abu Bekir's bid to inspect the company's financial records, with the High Court partially granting inspection before the company obtained an interim stay. The company also reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 18.2% year-on-year.
notable_en: The High Court partially granted shareholder Abu Bekir's bid to inspect the company's financial records, after which the company obtained an interim stay.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 18.2% year-on-year.
There were changes in the audit committee, with adjustments to the roles of Jeyabalan A/L S.K. Parasingam and Gee Siew Yoong.
risks_en: The litigation over shareholder Abu Bekir's inspection of the company's financial records is ongoing; the court partially granted inspection and the company obtained an interim stay.
Quarterly net income fell 6.8% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin declining from 8.6% to 7.7%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 291.974 million, up 18.2% year-on-year and 4.9% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR 22.441 million, down 6.8% quarter-on-quarter, with a net margin of 7.7% versus 8.6% in the prior quarter.
